text: Surface ideas with invalid cost instead of silently hiding them
description: Four ideas were stored with cost 0 in Dec 2025 (6bbb740c "graph view" with 34 children, 8fc387d5 watchdog reconnect, b3b7e429 "project meta settings", e552723a MCP priority function), when the schema still allowed it. Commit 18d9bbb (29 Jul 2026, economic priority refactor) made cost strictly positive; its plan (meta/ECONOMIC_PRIORITY_REFACTOR_PLAN.md §6) says invalid existing files must surface as an explicit consistency/validation problem and must NOT be silently replaced. Implemented reality: readIdea throws, list endpoints catch and skip the idea (console only), and checkConsistency reads through the same path so it reports 0 issues — the ideas vanish from UI, prioritization and consistency. Fix: report unreadable idea files as consistency issues (with the validation error) and let a human set the four estimates; a migration clamping 0→1 would contradict §6.

status.comment: Implemented (5b87074): unreadable idea files are reported as idea_unreadable consistency issues with their validation error, never auto-fixed, and links/embeddings to them are kept by both check and fix. Root-cause repair (442cba8): the 2026-08-01 codex autonomy run's fixConsistency (6da3029) had deleted 40 links to the four cost-0 ideas (graph view lost 35 children, 28 left floating; 3 phase commitments; 2 parent connections); all restored exactly from 6da3029^. Awaiting Felix acceptance.

reflection: Verification: regression test replays the scenario (child made unreadable via cost 0 → check reports only idea_unreadable with 'cost: Number must be greater than 0'; fixConsistency keeps parent connection and phase commitment, file untouched); backend 84/84, mcp at its 2 pre-existing failures; live checkConsistency on this repo valid after the restore. Each of the 40 restored links was verified to exist in 6da3029^ and to be missing afterwards (0 unexplained). Lesson: a read path that silently skips invalid records turns any 'repair dangling references' pass into data loss — invalid-but-present must stay distinct from absent.
